items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Flood Ivory; the mention is entirely within the interviewer's turns.

ctx.x: Joe Ivory and Flood. Flood and all of them was playing then.
Flood, what? Flood Ivory. Flood Ivory. What did he play? I don't know. He played ball. Oh, he played ball. I didn't know. I didn't know. I didn't know. It might be a musical instrument too.
